loginSubtitle: Sign in to your operations workspace.
loginHeroSub: A clearer workspace for the people who keep business moving.
ordersSubtitle: Find the right order. Keep things moving.
searchOrders: Search the beginning of a name or email…
searchHint: Search matches the beginning of the customer name or email.
noOrdersSub: Try a different name, email, or status.
deleteDescription: This order will be hidden from the console. Its record is retained for your audit history.
createSubtitle: A phone call. A few details. One new order.
customerDetailsSub: Who are we preparing this order for?
lineItemsSub: Choose up to 5 products. Prices come from your catalog.
serverPriceNote: Final prices and totals are verified when you save.
requiredFields: Fill in the customer details and select valid products and quantities.
safeSaveSub: Retries use the same operation, so you can safely try again.
savedDescription: Order #{id} is saved. You can start the next order.
restored: Your previous submission was restored from the server.
uncertainDescription: We couldn’t confirm whether the order was saved. Keep this page open and check its status; your previous attempt will be reused.
priceChanged: A product price changed. Review the updated total, then confirm again.
alreadyDeleted: This attempt belongs to an order that was removed. It has not been recreated.
draftLost: Only submitted details can be restored after closing this page.
name: Name
deactivateDescription: The agent will lose access immediately, including on devices already signed in.
agentAdded: Team member added. Ask them to change their initial password at first sign-in.
passwordHint: 12–128 characters. The agent must change it at first sign-in.
addAgentDescription: Create an agent account. Share the initial credentials directly with your teammate.
passwordSubtitle: Your initial password needs to be changed before you continue.
passwordOptionalSub: Changing your password signs out your other devices.
passwordMismatch: Passwords must match, contain 12–128 characters, and differ from the current password.
err_NETWORK_ERROR: We couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
err_INVALID_SESSION: Your session ended. Please sign in again.
err_VALIDATION_ERROR: Check the entered values and try again.
err_INTERNAL_ERROR: Something went wrong. Please try again.
err_CONFLICT: This email or unique value is already in use.
err_FORBIDDEN: You don’t have permission to do that.
err_CSRF_REJECTED: The request could not be verified. Refresh the page and try again.
err_TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS: Too many attempts. Please wait before trying again.
err_PRODUCT_UNAVAILABLE: A selected product is unavailable. Remove it or choose another.
err_IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT: Another tab submitted different details. Check the saved attempt before continuing.
err_ATTEMPT_UNRESOLVED: Resolve your previous submission before starting another.
err_ORDER_NOT_FOUND: This order is no longer available.
err_PASSWORD_CHANGE_REQUIRED: Change your initial password to continue.
err_ATTEMPT_NOT_FOUND: This save attempt could not be found. Check its status again.
err_INVALID_TOTAL: The order amount is outside the supported range.
validationDifferentPassword: Choose a different password from your current one.
validationQuantity: Enter a whole number from 1 to 1,000.
validationPageRange: Enter a valid page number within the available pages.
